purpose: 独立新门店泛化集验收预注册；采集前冻结，禁止用新集结果回流调规则

modes.A: rejection-only: final = e8g_pred AND verdict NOT IN {NON_MATCH,OUT_OF_SCOPE}

isolation.store_group: new store_id zero intersection with existing 322 groups (24 pos)
isolation.prompt_development: new set NEVER used for rule development; validation only

metrics: error-cost strata: competitor-falseMATCH / logo-falseMATCH / real-store-falseREJECT / UNKNOWN-fallback-falseACCEPT

pass_criteria_exploratory.necessary: modeA or modeB F1 point >=0.85 AND recall CI lower >=0.70
pass_criteria_exploratory.generalization_signal: new-set F1 vs exploratory F1 drop NOT significant within paired CI
pass_criteria_exploratory.not_required: B superiority over A (if crosses 0 -> equivalent, choose by business error cost)

prohibitions: no prompt/weight tuning on new set then re-report as generalization
no deploy/public accuracy claim before G0/G1
governance: rights pending_review; G0/G1 gate; exploratory only
